general.languageHint: The language of Torosu: System follows your computer's

downloader.saveCookieHint: Keep the osu_session cookie when Torosu closes. Off, it lasts only for this session

downloader.loadLibraryHint: Load the osu! library when opening the downloader, to skip maps you have

packs.maxSets: Max sets per pack (0 never splits)

trainer.hqAudioHint: Encode the new audio at ~192 kbit/s instead of ~128 kbit/s, half as big again
trainer.hqVideoHint: Re-encode a scaled video at a better quality, nearly twice as big
trainer.autoPitchHint: Keep the pitch below 1.0x and let it rise with the speed above, instead of choosing it in each rate change
trainer.openOszHint: Open each new .osz with osu!, so it is imported right away
trainer.shortcutsWayland: Not available on Wayland: an app can't listen to the keys while osu! has the focus
trainer.shortcutsHint: Convert the map selected in osu! with a preset while you play. Set each preset's keys in the Trainer, none are set at first

nameFormat.label: Name format
